findings.title: ORIGIN Opcode for Authentication
findings.description: ORIGIN Opcode for Authentication detected via bytecode analysis.
findings.evidence: ORIGIN (0x45) found 1 time(s). tx.origin should not be used for authentication.
findings.recommendation: Review the contract source code for origin opcode for authentication.

findings.title: CALL Without Staticcall (Potential Reentrancy)
findings.description: CALL Without Staticcall (Potential Reentrancy) detected via bytecode analysis.
findings.evidence: CALL (0xf1) found 2 time(s) with no STATICCALL. External calls without view-only pattern may be vulnerable to reentrancy.
findings.recommendation: Review the contract source code for call without staticcall (potential reentrancy).
